data.name: Vardhan
data.gender_notes: Vardhan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who expands or extends (Vas) and nourishes (Dhan) the world. The name Vardhan carries the meaning “God of abundance and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vardhan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of abundance and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine power of growth, expansion, and nourishment.
data.etymology: Vardhan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of abundance and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vardhan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Vardhan' is culturally significant in Hinduism as it reflects the idea of growth, expansion, and nourishment. In one of Vishnu's incarnations, he is known as 'Prithviraj Vardhan,' where 'Prithvi' refers to the Earth and 'Raj' means King. Here, Vardhan signifies the one who extends his protection and nourishment to the entire world. Vardhan is also acommon name for Lord Vishnu and Shiva, signifying their power to expand and nourish the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name 'Vardhan' represents the Divine's generosity and compassion towards Creation. It signifies the divine force that nourishes and sustains the soul. The phrase 'Vardhanaam Parah Panthavan' which means 'May the Lord who nourishes all be your supreme guide' is commonly used in Hindu scriptures. This name, therefore, serves as a constant reminder of the divine presence that sees growth and progress in the soul's spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vardhan: The nurturing, all-expansive one, who bestows growth and fulfillment in all aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vardhan is a name of Lord Vishnu in Hinduism. The name Vardhan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
